title: 独立浅口炒锅

source.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable transparent paper-theatre animation cutout. Primary request: one standalone shallow Chinese frying pan for a home cooking explainer. Subject: single medium round carbon-steel skillet with low sloped sides, pale wood handle extending to the right, empty clean interior seen from a gentle elevated three-quarter angle; no food, no lid, no stove, no hand. Style/medium: refined tactile cut-paper collage, charcoal-gray pan with subtle paper grain and restrained warm wood handle, crisp edge. Composition/framing: one object centered and fully visible, handle not cropped, generous transparent margin. Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Constraints: no background card, counter, burner, flame, steam, cast shadow, glow, labels, logo, text or watermark.

discovery.usage_notes: 空锅独立层；锅铲、食材和加热状态另取，不含锅内结果。

usage_notes: 可与电磁炉、锅铲和现有蔬菜/鱼肉组合；翻炒轨迹仍需当前镜头实现。
